overview_description.description: Recraft is a generative AI design platform that enables professional designers, illustrators, and marketers to create high-quality visuals. The company's proprietary model, Recraft V3, allows for precise control over visual elements, including the placement and appearance of text and images, catering to the needs of designers seeking brand consistency. The platform offers features such as an AI image generator, vectorizer, photo editor, mockup generator, image upscaler, background remover, and AI eraser. Recraft's infinite canvas supports real-time collaboration, making it suitable for teams working on branding and marketing projects. The company has attracted users from various industries, including professionals from organizations like Ogilvy, HubSpot, Netflix, Asana, and Airbus.

product.name: AI Image Generator
product.description: Generates images from text prompts using a custom AI model designed for creative control and structured output.

product.name: AI Vector Generator
product.description: Creates vector graphics from text prompts or images, enabling scalable and editable design assets.

product.name: AI Image Vectorizer
product.description: Converts raster images like PNG or JPG into vector formats such as SVG for scalable design use.

product.name: Mockup Generator
product.description: Transforms photos of products into production-quality mockups for branding and marketing presentations.

product.name: Image Upscaler
product.description: Enhances image resolution by increasing sharpness and detail to produce high-quality visuals.

product.name: Background Remover
product.description: Removes or replaces image backgrounds to isolate subjects or create transparent backgrounds.
